name: Calls that failed
detail: A failed model call is often still charged for what it was sent. This is the price-table estimate of those calls, not a statement of what the provider billed.

name: Runs that ended in failure
detail: Assumes what was done before the failure did not reach its goal. A run that failed late may have finished part of its work; the records cannot say. Whether a run was abandoned is not recorded, so only failure counts.

name: Retries
detail: A retry that succeeded was needed to get the work done. The cost of retries that failed again is what assumes the repeat was not needed.

name: Calls repeated in a row
detail: Assumes the repeats beyond the first were not needed. A poll, a pagination that does not change the target or a retry policy looks the same in the records.

name: Loops
detail: Assumes calls beyond the 5th with identical content did not add anything. Only calls that carry a content hash can be checked.

name: Runs cut off by a limit
detail: Assumes the work was not finished when the limit was reached. Only model calls whose source states why they stopped can be seen; a step limit is not recorded by any source Provantix reads.
